description: Extracts name/email/date from the Slack command
Picks an onboarding buddy by taking the first person from the rebalanced round-robin queue (avoids assigning someone already overloaded)
Looks for the next free slot on the assigned buddy's calendar
Schedules the welcome meeting between the buddy and the new hire
Mirrors the welcome meeting onto Google Calendar
Posts a welcome message to the team channel
Appends a row to the shared onboarding checklist (name
Generates the signed audit receipt for all actions taken
